entries.title: Quiz says how many questions there are
entries.body: In Quiz, the information card gives the number of questions in all. When "Only what I've read" leaves some out, the line saying how many there are in all, and how many are about passages you have not read yet, sits beside the "Question 1 of…" count rather than under the closed list of questions.

entries.title: Wide tables can be scrolled from the keyboard
entries.body: When the table in your library is too wide to fit and scrolls sideways, you can move to it with the keyboard, and a screen reader announces it by the table's name. Before, in Safari, someone using only the keyboard could not reach the columns that were out of view.

entries.title: Your place in an article stays yours
entries.body: Two people signing in on the same browser could be shown each other's place in an article, including just after one signed out and the other signed in. The place you reached, and Search's record of paired quick and thorough searches, are kept separately for each account. Saved searches are not deleted.

entries.title: Incomplete replies no longer replace what you see
entries.body: If Quiz, Summary, Ideas, Timeline, Debate, Glossary or Quotes received an incomplete reply while refreshing, the app could show the missing content in place of what was there. It keeps what was already on screen and shows its usual error message instead.
